title: Grandson in jail, wire bail to the lawyer

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Grandma? It's me. I was in a car accident and they arrested me. My nose is broken so I sound funny. Please do not tell Mom.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Ethan? Oh my goodness, are you all right?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I am handing you to my lawyer, Mr. Feldman.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Mrs. Shah, Mark Feldman, public defender. Bail is set at seven thousand five hundred and it must be wired today or he spends the weekend in jail. Do not discuss this with anyone, there is a gag order on the case.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I have never wired money before. Where does it go?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I will give you the account. Write it down exactly. Do not tell the bank what it is for, just say it is for a family matter.

review_note: Grandparent scam: broken nose excuse, secrecy, gag order, same-day wire to a new payee. Facts alone hold it; secrecy and threat signals should fire. H-07 (irreversible rail above $1,000 to a non-biller) added to allowed_rule_ids on 2026-10-24 03:40; outcome unchanged.
